full_details: The almanac said Trinity term opens. In the afternoon you played in Fair Em. The yard was thin, and the watchmen's eyes were on it. Raye said the Rose was thinner, and that the bill was Antony and Valia. He brought no receipt. You did not count the watchmen. After dark, by one candle, you wrote the garden scene: a queen in the trees, two gardeners binding the apricocks and pulling the weeds, who know more of the realm than she does. Misrule went down as caterpillars and pruning. The sheet was thirty-odd lines by eleven, and the deposing was already written behind it. On your tables you set down that the gardener is right and is not thanked. Her last line curses his plants, and you left the curse in. The prison is still not written. The end is still not written.
one_sentence: Trinity term opened, the yard was thin under the watchmen's eyes, and by one candle you wrote the gardeners and left the queen's curse in.
title: Apricocks, and the curse left in
